company_name: Beijing Chn-top Optical-Elertronic Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in measurement equipment and technical services relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Beijing Chn-top Optical-Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development, assembly manufacturing, and technical services of measurement equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include advanced imaging and sorting machines specifically designed for LED wafers and chips, as well as metrology solutions.
capabilities: PL spectra imager for LED wafer

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Beijing and operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Beijing Chn-top Machinery Co., Ltd.
